# polite-scraper

> Fetch web pages politely with RFC 9309 robots.txt, per-host pacing, conditional caching, SSRF guards, size limits and text extraction. Python package `trysac-polite-scraper`, import name `polite_scraper`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
